display_name.description: Provider display name shown in the login UI

kind.description: Marketplace/provider family identifier such as google, github, gitlab, entra, discord, linkedin, or custom

protocol.description: Runtime adapter used to connect to the provider

connection.description: Protocol-specific connection settings such as issuer, authorization_url, token_url, userinfo_url, client_id, client_secret, scopes, and tenant knobs

mapping.description: Inbound claim mapping from provider claims to Zitadel schema fields

target.description: User schema target for first-login create/link behavior

linking.description: Controls whether the provider can create users, link existing users, or both

session.description: Session-related provider defaults and future knobs

ui.description: Login UI settings for this provider

catalog_ref.description: Marketplace origin metadata for installed providers
